description: Score your decision on a sandbox case. Tell it whether you would have credited the payment and for how much, and it replies with whether that was correct and, if not, exactly what the error would have cost you in real units. This is the fastest way to find out whether your payment handling is actually safe.

amount.description: If crediting, how much, in the asset's smallest units.

credit.description: Would you have credited this payment?

name: check_sandbox_answer
